title: Coauthorship among the top 80
description: One row per undirected OpenAlex author pair, weighted by distinct shared snapshot works (2021–2024), regardless of either author’s work-specific affiliation.
code:
q='''WITH counts AS (SELECT author_id, count(DISTINCT work_id) works, min(author_name) fallback FROM authorships WHERE is_columbia AND author_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1), ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER(ORDER BY works DESC,author_id) rank FROM counts QUALIFY rank<=80) '''
n=sql(q+'''SELECT ranked.author_id id,coalesce(authors.name,fallback) name,rank,works FROM ranked LEFT JOIN authors USING(author_id) ORDER BY rank''')
e=sql(q+''', byline AS (SELECT DISTINCT work_id,author_id FROM authorships JOIN ranked USING(author_id)) SELECT a.author_id source,b.author_id target,count(*) shared FROM byline a JOIN byline b USING(work_id) WHERE a.author_id<b.author_id GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY shared DESC,source,target''')
import networkx as nx
g=nx.Graph(); g.add_nodes_from(n.id); g.add_weighted_edges_from(e.itertuples(index=False,name=None)); n['partners']=n.id.map(dict(g.degree())); comps=sorted(nx.connected_components(g),key=lambda s:(-len(s),min(s))); n['component']=n.id.map({a:i+1 for i,c in enumerate(comps) for a in c}); print(n.head(10)); print(e.head(10)); print(e.shared.describe(),len(comps),[len(c) for c in comps]); print(n[n.partners==0][['name','rank']]); print(save_table(n,'Top 80 Columbia researchers','One row per OpenAlex author ID, ranked by distinct Columbia-affiliated snapshot works (2021–2024), with unique cohort collaborators and component id.')); print(save_table(e,'Coauthorship among the top 80','One row per undirected OpenAlex author pair, weighted by distinct shared snapshot works (2021–2024), regardless of either author’s work-specific affiliation.'))
